# GTMObserver — Complete Technical Architecture & Knowledge Base

## Product Overview
GTMObserver (https://gtmobserver.com | https://app.gtmobserver.com) is an edge-native analytics governance and automation SaaS platform built on Cloudflare Workers and Cloudflare D1. It empowers digital marketing agencies, hospitality management groups, e-commerce teams, and solo operators to isolate client properties across Personal Workspaces and Organizations, automate Google Tag Manager deployments, run GTM & 22-point GA4 property audits (with branded A4 PDF reports), and monitor GA4 telemetry continuously from the edge.

## Workspace, Organization & Access Control Model
- **Personal & Organization Sign-Up**:
  - Users can sign up on `/sign-up` under either a **Personal** solo workspace or an **Organization** team portfolio (`/choose-organization`).
  - Native Clerk Organizations integration enables switching workspaces in the sidebar, inviting team members, managing Admin/Member roles (`/access` and `/settings`), and removing organizations while safely preserving all projects inside the user's Personal Workspace.
- **Organization & Project Isolation**:
  - Organization Dashboard (`/organization`) and scoped Organization Dashboards (`/organizations/:orgId`) support managing 50+ client websites across Card and Table views with search, health filters, industry chips, bulk organization assignment, bulk sharing, and bulk Trash.
  - Each project opens into a strictly isolated workspace (`/projects/:projectId/dashboard`, `/gtm`, `/observer`, `/analytics`, `/settings`).
- **Universal Per-Project Sharing**:
  - Collaborators can be granted `viewer`, `editor`, or `admin` access across individual or bulk-selected projects by email, even across Personal accounts. Pending grants are automatically claimed upon sign-in/sign-up.
- **Safe Trash & Automatic Monitor Closure**:
  - Moving a project to Trash immediately closes all project-scoped GA4 Observer monitors so background cron sweeps stop evaluating or emailing stale alerts.
  - Projects in Trash can be **Restored**, **Permanently Deleted** (cascading cleanup of monitors, alert logs, audit logs, and sharing grants), or cleared via **Empty Trash** without altering live Google Analytics or Google Tag Manager accounts.

## Architecture & Security
- **Runtime**: Cloudflare Workers + Hono router (`src/worker.ts`) and Cloudflare Browser Rendering (`env.BROWSER`) for server-rendered A4 PDF generation.
- **Database**: Cloudflare D1 (`gtm_automation_d1`) storing organizations, team memberships, universal project access grants, project bindings, GA4 Observer monitors/alerts, GTM & GA4 audit history, and Polar billing metadata.
- **Authentication & Security Controls**:
  - Clerk authentication with RS256 JWKS verification on every `/api/*` endpoint (`401` fail-closed on missing/invalid JWTs).
  - HMAC-SHA256 signed Google OAuth2 state tokens with timing-safe signature verification.
  - Standard Webhooks signature verification on Polar.sh billing webhooks (`POST /api/polar/webhook`).
  - Strict origin CORS allowlist (`gtmobserver.com`, `app.gtmobserver.com`), `Cache-Control: no-store, private` on API responses, HSTS (`preload`), `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `X-Frame-Options: DENY`, and HTML escaping on alert templates.
- **Billing Infrastructure**: Polar.sh live catalog sync, checkout sessions, and one-click Customer Portal (`/billing`).
- **Email Infrastructure**: Resend API with verified SPF/DKIM/DMARC domain deliverability (`alerts@gtmobserver.com`) and PDF attachments.
- **Scheduled Monitoring**: Cloudflare Cron Trigger (`*/15 * * * *`) evaluating active, non-trashed monitors every 15 minutes against local IANA timezones with daily deduplication (`last_run_local_date`).

## Supported GTM Recipe Modules
- **Basic & Outbound Click Listeners**:
  - `tel:` phone links, `mailto:` email links, external outbound links, social platforms (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, Twitter/X), Maps/Directions (GMB, Apple Maps, Waze), OTA links (TripAdvisor, Booking.com, Expedia, Agoda).
- **Engagement & DataLayers**:
  - Scroll Depth (25%, 50%, 75%, 90%), Video tracking (YouTube, Vimeo, HTML5 play/pause/complete), Universal Social engagement, and optional Meta Pixel / Google Ads conversion tags.
- **Forms & Lead Generation**:
  - Elementor, Contact Form 7 (CF7), Gravity Forms, HubSpot, Salesforce, Revinate, Zmail Direct newsletter iframes, Generic HTML forms, and custom PHP (`sendmail.php`) forms across RFP, Newsletter, Contact, and Generic intents.
- **Hospitality & Hotel Booking Engines**:
  - Standard e-commerce funnel & booking entrance link tracking for **StayNTouch**, **Synxis / SBE**, **Windsurfer**, **Mews**, **iHotelier**, and **Safara**.
- **E-Commerce GA4 DataLayers**:
  - WooCommerce Standard GA4 E-Commerce (`view_item`, `add_to_cart`, `remove_from_cart`, `view_cart`, `begin_checkout`, `purchase`).

## GTM Workspace Audit & 22-Point GA4 Property Audit
- **GTM Health Audit (`/api/gtm/audit`, `/api/gtm/audits/:auditId/pdf`)**:
  - Detects duplicate tags firing on identical triggers (-20 pts), shared triggers (-5 pts), and orphaned triggers/variables (-5 pts), with downloadable A4 PDF reports.
- **22-Point GA4 Property Audit (`/api/ga4/audit`, `/api/ga4/audits/:auditId/pdf`)**:
  - Audits cross-domain & referral exclusions (booking engines, payment gateways, localhost/staging pollution), 9 integrations (Search Console, Google Ads, BigQuery, Signals, Enhanced Measurement, DV360, SA360, AdSense, Measurement Protocol Secrets), property retention & attribution settings, URL PII/query leakage, unassigned traffic, and Key Events / conversion integrity with branded A4 PDF exports.

## GA4 Telemetry Anomaly Detection Engine
- **14 Metrics**: `sessions`, `activeUsers`, `totalUsers`, `newUsers`, `engagementRate`, `bounceRate`, `averageSessionDuration`, `keyEvents`, `transactions`, `totalRevenue`, `ecommercePurchases`, `sessionKeyEventRate`, `screenPageViews`, `eventCount`.
- **11 Comparison Windows**: Yesterday vs Last Week, Day over Day, Rolling/Calendar Week-over-Week, Calendar/Rolling Month-over-Month, 28-Day Cycle, YoY 7-Day, YoY 30-Day, YoY Calendar Month, and YoY Single Day.
- **6 Condition Operators**: Drops Below %, Spikes Above %, Changes +/-%, Equals 0 (Outage), Falls Under Value, Exceeds Value.
- **Templates & Logic**: 20 starter templates across 6 industry categories, compound `Match ANY` / `Match ALL` rules, Traffic Source/Medium and Device Category filters, and on-demand live **Test & Send Report** execution.
